definitions.gloss: different theory; dissenting view; alternative interpretation
definitions.explanation: A theory or opinion that differs from the mainstream or commonly accepted view. Often used in academic, historical, and scholarly discussions.

examples.japanese: この{問題|もんだい}には{異説|いせつ}もある。
examples.english: There are also dissenting views on this issue.

examples.japanese: {異説|いせつ}を{唱|とな}える{学者|がくしゃ}もいる。
examples.english: There are scholars who propose alternative theories.

examples.japanese: {通説|つうせつ}に{対|たい}して{有力|ゆうりょく}な{異説|いせつ}が{提出|ていしゅつ}され、{議論|ぎろん}が{続|つづ}いている。
examples.english: A compelling alternative theory has been put forward against the accepted view, and the debate continues.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {異|い} (different, unusual) + {説|せつ} (theory, opinion). Used in academic and intellectual discussions to refer to a view that challenges the mainstream or established position.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {異説|いせつ}を{唱|とな}える (to propose a dissenting theory)
- {異説|いせつ}がある (there are alternative views)
- {有力|ゆうりょく}な{異説|いせつ} (a compelling alternative theory)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {通説|つうせつ}: accepted/conventional theory — the mainstream view that {異説|いせつ} challenges
- {異論|いろん}: objection, dissent — focuses more on disagreement than on an alternative theory
- {新説|しんせつ}: new theory — a freshly proposed idea, not necessarily opposing the mainstream
